<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TabsRootEmits, TabsRootProps } from "reka-ui"
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { reactiveOmit } from "@vueuse/core"
import { TabsRoot, useForwardPropsEmits } from "reka-ui"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const props = defineProps<TabsRootProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>()
const emits = defineEmits<TabsRootEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, "class")
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <TabsRoot
    v-slot="slotProps"
    data-slot="tabs"
    :data-orientation="forwarded.orientation || 'horizontal'"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('gap-2 group/tabs flex data-horizontal:flex-col', props.class)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </TabsRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TabsContentProps } from "reka-ui"
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { reactiveOmit } from "@vueuse/core"
import { TabsContent } from "reka-ui"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const props = defineProps<TabsContentProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, "class")
</script>

<template>
  <TabsContent
    data-slot="tabs-content"
    :class="cn('text-sm flex-1 outline-none', props.class)"
    v-bind="delegatedProps"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsContent>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TabsIndicatorProps } from "reka-ui";
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import type { TabsListVariants } from ".";
import { reactiveOmit } from "@vueuse/core";
import { TabsIndicator } from "reka-ui";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

/*
  Animated active-tab indicator, auto-rendered by TabsList. Reka publishes the
  active trigger's geometry as CSS vars; offsetLeft/translateX are both
  physical, so the pair stays correct in RTL without logical utilities. Written
  as arbitrary properties on purpose: the shadcn-vue CLI's rtl transform rewrites
  physical translate utilities and would inject a broken `rtl:` twin.
  Horizontal-orientation styling only (the kit has no vertical tabs).
*/
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<
    TabsIndicatorProps & {
      class?: HTMLAttributes["class"];
      variant?: TabsListVariants["variant"];
    }
  >(),
  {
    variant: "default",
  },
);

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, "class", "variant");
</script>

<template>
  <TabsIndicator
    data-slot="tabs-indicator"
    v-bind="delegatedProps"
    :class="
      cn(
        'pointer-events-none absolute [left:0] [width:var(--reka-tabs-indicator-size)] [translate:var(--reka-tabs-indicator-position)] transition-[translate,width] duration-300 ease-out',
        variant === 'default'
          ? 'inset-y-1 rounded-lg bg-primary/15 dark:bg-primary/20'
          : '-bottom-px h-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary',
        props.class,
      )
    "
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TabsListProps } from "reka-ui";
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import type { TabsListVariants } from ".";
import { reactiveOmit, usePreferredReducedMotion } from "@vueuse/core";
import { TabsList } from "reka-ui";
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, useTemplateRef } from "vue";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { tabsListVariants } from ".";
import TabsIndicator from "./TabsIndicator.vue";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<
    TabsListProps & {
      class?: HTMLAttributes["class"];
      variant?: TabsListVariants["variant"];
    }
  >(),
  {
    variant: "default",
  },
);

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, "class", "variant");

// On phones the list is a horizontal scroll strip: keep the active trigger
// fully visible whenever it changes (tap on a half-clipped tab, or a route
// that opens on a later tab). Observed via data-state so it works without
// reaching into reka's context. Native `inline: nearest` is RTL-aware.
const listEl = useTemplateRef<InstanceType<typeof TabsList>>("list");
const motion = usePreferredReducedMotion();

function revealActive() {
  const root = (listEl.value as unknown as { $el?: HTMLElement } | null)?.$el;
  if (!root || root.scrollWidth <= root.clientWidth) return;
  const active = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-slot="tabs-trigger"][data-state="active"]');
  active?.scrollIntoView({
    block: "nearest",
    inline: "nearest",
    behavior: motion.value === "reduce" ? "auto" : "smooth",
  });
}

let observer: MutationObserver | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
  const root = (listEl.value as unknown as { $el?: HTMLElement } | null)?.$el;
  if (!root) return;
  revealActive();
  observer = new MutationObserver(revealActive);
  observer.observe(root, { subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["data-state"] });
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());
</script>

<template>
  <TabsList
    ref="list"
    data-slot="tabs-list"
    :data-variant="variant"
    v-bind="delegatedProps"
    :class="cn(tabsListVariants({ variant }), props.class)"
  >
    <TabsIndicator :variant="variant" />
    <slot />
  </TabsList>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TabsTriggerProps } from "reka-ui";
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { reactiveOmit } from "@vueuse/core";
import { TabsTrigger, useForwardProps } from "reka-ui";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps<TabsTriggerProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>();

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, "class");

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(delegatedProps);
</script>

<template>
  <TabsTrigger
    data-slot="tabs-trigger"
    :class="
      cn(
        'relative inline-flex h-full shrink-0 snap-start items-center justify-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap border border-transparent px-3 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 group-data-vertical/tabs:h-9 group-data-vertical/tabs:w-full group-data-vertical/tabs:justify-start [&_svg:not([class*=size-])]:size-4 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0',
        'group-data-[variant=default]/tabs-list:rounded-md group-data-[variant=default]/tabs-list:data-active:text-primary',
        'group-data-[variant=line]/tabs-list:data-active:text-foreground',
        props.class,
      )
    "
    v-bind="forwardedProps"
  >
    <slot />
  </TabsTrigger>
</template>
